child.label: Characters & Pop Culture
child.description: Questions about choosing between fictional characters, celebrities, franchises, games, mythical figures, or famous creatures to be, fight, own, or meet.
child.not_for: Choices about your own looks or body (use Body & Appearance); eating or gross-out dares (use Food & Gross-Outs); injuries, dangers, or ways to die (use Pain, Danger & Death).
examples: Which would you rather? Be Batman / Be Superman
Which would you rather? Only watch Star Wars / Only watch Star Trek

child.label: Body & Appearance

child.not_for: Picking a fictional character or celebrity to be (use Characters & Pop Culture); disgusting things to eat or bodily-function embarrassments (use Food & Gross-Outs); losing limbs through injury or painful harm (use Pain, Danger & Death).

child.label: Food & Gross-Outs
child.description: Questions about choosing between foods, drinks, disgusting things to eat or lick, and embarrassing bodily functions like farting or not showering.

Which would you rather? Lick a subway pole / Eat a bug

child.label: Pain, Danger & Death
child.description: Questions about choosing between painful injuries, dangerous situations, punishments, grim fates, or ways to die.
child.not_for: Harmless changes to your looks (use Body & Appearance); disgusting food or bodily-function dares (use Food & Gross-Outs); picking fictional characters to be (use Characters & Pop Culture).
examples: Which would you rather? Be stung by a jellyfish / Be bitten by a snake
Which would you rather? Go to jail for a year / Lose all your money
